What is the Kaching Subscriptions app?

Kaching Subscriptions is a lightweight, conversion-focused recurring-billing app for Shopify, built by the team behind Kaching Bundles. It lets merchants add pay-per-delivery and prepaid subscription plans quickly, gives customers a self-service portal to skip, pause, swap, and cancel, and includes smart payment recovery and automatic post-order product actions. It charges a flat monthly fee with no transaction fees, tiered by subscription revenue up to an Enterprise plan.

It’s a capable app for growing stores. But depending on the depth a subscription business needs — around live support, retention journeys, native bundling, and loyalty — merchants often look for a more complete alternative: Appstle Subscriptions.

What is Appstle Subscriptions?

Appstle Subscriptions helps Shopify and Shopify Plus stores manage subscriptions and recurring payments, with many subscription models to increase loyalty and lifetime value.

It’s trusted by 40,000+ Shopify and Shopify Plus merchants and has 4,000+ reviews.

Key capabilities:

  • Fast install and setup for subscriptions
  • Personalization and customization at bulk and individual customer levels
  • Upselling features and easy plan management
  • 24x7x365 human customer support, guidance, and assistance
  • Multi-tier discounts; custom shipping, dunning, and cancellation management
  • Real-time performance data
  • Seamless, free migration from other subscriptions apps
  • Auto-billing, unlimited personalized email notifications, and highly customizable functionality

Why Appstle is the best alternative to Kaching

Customer support

Support quality is one of the biggest differentiators between apps that look similar on a feature list. Both apps advertise round-the-clock live support, so the real question is depth and scale.

Appstle offers a genuine 24/7/365 human-to-human support experience, backed by a large team serving 40,000+ merchants. Instead of a bot or a next-business-day queue, you reach an actual expert — many of them engineers — directly from a live chat widget in your merchant dashboard, at any hour.

Addition of new functionalities

How quickly a platform adapts can make or break its performance. Kaching does not offer per-merchant custom development, though merchant feature requests do influence its roadmap. Appstle combines a customer-centric approach with enterprise engineering capacity: it ships new functionality quickly and, for merchants with specific needs, is known for building and accommodating custom requirements.

Fees and charges on transactions

Both apps share an important strength: both charge 0% transaction fees on their paid plans. There’s one practical difference in how each handles the entry tier:

  • Kaching: 0% transaction fees on every paid plan (Starter $9.99, Basic $14.99, Growth $24.99, and higher tiers), each capped by monthly subscription revenue. Its free plan is limited to development stores, so a live store using the 0% model starts on a paid plan.
  • Appstle: 0% / no transaction fee on all plans — including a genuine free plan usable by live stores (up to $500/month in subscription revenue) — with multiple plans from free to enterprise and no hidden charges.

Where Appstle extends the value is what surrounds that zero-fee pricing: deeper retention tooling, native bundling and loyalty, journeys, and 24/7/365 support — all without a per-transaction cut of your revenue.

Customization

Appstle allows strong integrations with leading Shopify and marketing apps (Klaviyo, PageFly, Yotpo, Gorgias, Omnisend, Rebuy, Zapier), custom shipping profiles, a custom subscription widget, a custom email domain, and custom pricing. Kaching supports portal, widget, and email customization, but not the same custom-integration and custom-development depth.

Customer engagement and loyalty

Kaching includes retention offers in its cancellation flow, but does not include built-in loyalty or gamified engagement tools. Appstle Subscriptions & Loyalty is built to drive engagement:

  • Special discounts and shipping benefits for long-term subscribers
  • Subscription trials and gifts for loyal customers; upselling to add value
  • Customer-controlled skip / swap products and flexible skip/stop controls
  • Automated personalized emails; native build-a-box and bundling; bulk automations; activity logs and timelines

Comprehensive features on one platform

The more your app does natively, the fewer apps you stitch together. Notably, Kaching’s build-a-box and classic bundles require its separate Kaching Bundles app — so a full box-subscription setup means running two apps. Appstle keeps these native and unified, alongside upselling, multi-tier discounts, cancellation management, and real-time analytics:

  • Multiple plan types: pay-as-you-go, curated boxes, unlimited, fixed usage, and more
  • Subscribed product swap without cancel-and-recreate (reduces churn)
  • One-time product inclusion; auto-billing; custom shipping with multiple profiles
  • Recapture of failed transactions; real-time performance tracker; native build-a-box — no second app required

Flexibility

Both apps handle core flexibility — frequencies, pause/skip/cancel, and automatic post-order product actions. Appstle goes further with highly customizable functionality and CSS from the dashboard, custom shipping profiles by weight and order value, plan management from product pages and the merchant portal, and a visual subscription journey / flow builder for scheduled, rule-based lifecycle changes.

Seamless migration from other apps

Being straight about parity: Kaching also offers free, done-for-you migration with a dedicated support thread. Where Appstle stands out is the depth of its technical customer success team, which provides hand-holding through transition and business-continuity phases, plus a real-time performance tracker for visibility during and after the move. Merchants shifting to Appstle rarely experience business-flow disruption.

Ready to try Appstle Subscriptions & Loyalty?

Whether you’re launching subscriptions or comparing alternatives to Kaching, Appstle matches Kaching’s zero-fee pricing while adding 24/7/365 human support, native bundling and loyalty, journeys, and rapid custom development. Install Appstle and contact our support team, or reach out for a hand.
